_doc: The cost-to-find SEED a run is handed: the measured table shrunk geometrically toward its own median price. Read once, into the price model's seed; the in-run estimate moves away from it within a few served batches. `price_clamp` is the band that estimate may occupy around THIS seed. Regenerate with `fractal-wallpapers derive-prices --regularize`; never hand-edit a row, and never edit the measured table it is derived from.

_provenance.estimand: the measured seed, shrunk toward the measured median in LOG space
_provenance.formula: seed_p = exp(alpha * ln(price_p) + (1 - alpha) * ln(median(measured prices)))
_provenance.alpha_basis: Allocation share is deficit/price, so seeding the raw table hands a run's first batches a 12x spread asserted on one run's telemetry, and seeding a flat table asserts a spread of 1x on nothing. Shrinkage is the middle: every partition keeps its measured ORDER and alpha of its log-distance from the median, so a 10x signal survives as a 5x one instead of being flattened to a bound. 0.9 because the source is a 183-minute production run rather than a warm-up hour — there is not much uncertainty left for the shrink to absorb.
_provenance.price_clamp_basis: The band the LIVE estimate may occupy around this seed. A 4x band bound three of nine partitions for a whole run in the source project — the run had measured 15.6x, 18.1x and 5.0x and reported 4.0x for all three — and a run quoting the band instead of its own measurement is a run that is not measuring. 16x is wide enough to hold every ratio that run produced.
_provenance.price_clamp_applies_to: the in-run estimate only; it moves no price in this file
_provenance.shrink_target_population: MEASURED rows only. A defaulted row carries seed_price because it has no measurement; shrinking it would manufacture a price for a partition nobody priced, and letting it into the median would drag the target toward the flat seed by however many partitions went unserved.
_provenance.source_is_pristine: the measured table is read-only to the regularizer and is never rewritten: it is the evidence, this is a policy on top of it, and a policy that edits its evidence cannot be re-derived at another alpha
